1.en: V. The Certainty and Truth of Reason
1.zh: V. 理性的确定性与真理

en: In the thought that it has grasped, namely that the individual consciousness is in itself absolute essence, consciousness withdraws into itself.
For the unhappy consciousness, being-in-itself is the beyond of itself.

But its movement has accomplished this in it: to have posited individuality in its complete development, or the individuality that is actual consciousness, as the negative of itself, namely as the objective extreme, or to have wrested its being-for-itself out of itself and made it into being; therein its unity with this universal has also come to be for it, a unity which for us, since the sublated individual is the universal, no longer falls outside it, and, since consciousness maintains itself in this its negativity, is its essence on it as such.

Its truth is that which in the syllogism in which the extremes appeared absolutely held apart shows itself as the middle, which declares to the unchangeable consciousness that the individual has renounced itself, and to the individual that the unchangeable is no longer an extreme for it but is reconciled with it.

This middle is the unity that immediately knows both and relates them, and the consciousness of their unity, which it expresses to consciousness and thereby to itself, [is] the certainty of being all truth.
zh: 意识在它已经把握到的那个思想里，即个别意识自在地就是绝对本质，退回到自身之中。
对苦恼意识来说，自在存在是它自身的彼岸。
但它的运动已经在它身上做到了这一点：把在其完整发展中的个别性，或者把那个是现实意识的个别性，设定为它自身的否定物，也就是设定为对象性的极端，或者把它的自为存在从自身中争出来并使之成为存在；在这里，它和这一普遍物的统一也已经成为对它而言的统一，而这种统一对我们来说——由于被扬弃的个别之物就是普遍物——不再落到它之外，并且——由于意识在其这种否定性中保持自身——就在它身上、作为这样的它，是它的本质。
它的真理就是那个在两端绝对分离地出现于其中的推论里作为中项而出现的东西，这一中项对不变的意识说出：个别之物已经放弃了自己，并且对个别之物说出：不变者不再是它的一个极端，而是与它和解了。
这一中项是直接知道两者并把两者联系起来的那种统一，而关于两者之统一的意识，即它向意识、并由此向自身说出的那种统一，〔就是〕自己是全部真理的确定性。

en: In that self-consciousness is reason, its hitherto negative relation to otherness turns into a positive one.

Hitherto it has been concerned only with its independence and freedom, with saving and preserving itself for itself at the cost of the world or of its own actuality, both of which appeared to it as the negative of its essence.

But as reason, assured of itself, it has received calmness toward them and can endure them; for it is certain of itself as reality, or that all actuality is nothing other than it; its thinking is immediately itself actuality; it therefore relates to it as idealism.

In grasping itself thus, it seems to it as if the world were only now becoming for it; before, it does not understand it; it desires it and works upon it, withdraws out of it into itself, and annihilates it for itself and itself as consciousness — as consciousness of it as of the essence as well as consciousness of its nullity.

Only herein, after the grave of its truth has been lost, the annihilation of its actuality itself annihilated, and the individuality of consciousness is to it in itself absolute essence, does it discover it as its new actual world, which in its persistence has interest for it as previously only in its vanishing; for its subsistence becomes for it its own truth and presence: it is certain of experiencing only itself therein.
zh: 随着自我意识就是理性，它此前对他在的否定关系就转变成肯定的关系。
此前它关心的只是自己的独立性和自由，只是要牺牲世界或它自己的现实性，来为它自己拯救和保存自己，而这两者对它来说都显得是它本质的否定物。
但作为理性、作为确信自身的理性，它已经对它们获得了平静，并且能够忍受它们；因为它确信自己就是实在性，或者确信一切现实性无非就是它；它的思维直接就是现实性；所以它以观念论的方式对待现实性。
当它这样把握自己时，在它看来就好像世界现在才为它产生出来；此前它并不理解世界；它欲望世界并加工世界，从世界中退回自身，并为它自己消灭世界，也消灭作为意识的自己——既作为把世界看作本质的意识，也作为意识到世界之虚无性的意识。
只有在这里，在它的真理的坟墓已经失去、它的现实性的消灭本身也被消灭、意识的个别性自在地就是绝对本质之后，它才发现世界是它的新的现实世界，这一世界在它的持续中存在对它有意义，正如先前只在它的消失中才有意义；因为世界的持存成为它自己的真理和当前在场：它确信在其中经验到的只是自己。

en: Reason is the certainty of consciousness that it is all reality; thus idealism expresses its concept.

Just as the consciousness that appears as reason immediately has that certainty in itself, so too does idealism immediately express it: I am I, in the sense that the I which is object to me is not, as in self-consciousness in general, nor yet as in free self-consciousness — there only empty object in general, here only object that withdraws from the others which still count alongside it — but object with the consciousness of the non-being of any other, the sole object, all reality and presence.
But self-consciousness is not only for itself but also in itself all reality only by becoming this reality, or rather by proving itself to be such.

It proves itself thus in the course in which first, in the dialectical movement of meaning, perceiving and the understanding, otherness vanishes as something in itself, and then, in the movement through the independence of consciousness in lordship and bondage, through the thought of freedom, the sceptical liberation and the struggle of the absolute liberation of the consciousness divided within itself, otherness, insofar as it is only for it, vanishes for it itself.
Two sides appeared one after the other, the one in which the essence or the true had, for consciousness, the determinacy of being, the other [in which it] had that of being only for it.
But both reduced themselves to one truth: that what is, or the in-itself, is only insofar as it is for consciousness, and what is for it is also in itself.
The consciousness that is this truth has this path behind it and forgotten, in that it appears immediately as reason; or this immediately appearing reason appears only as the certainty of that truth.
Thus it only assures [us] that it is all reality, but does not itself comprehend this; for that forgotten path is the comprehending of this immediately expressed assertion.
And likewise, for one who has not made it, this assertion, when he hears it in this pure form — for in a concrete shape he surely makes it himself — is incomprehensible.
zh: 理性是意识确信自己是一切实在性；观念论说出的就是理性的概念。
正如作为理性出现的意识直接就在自身中具有那种确定性，观念论也直接说出了它：我就是我，其意义是：对我而言是对象的那个我，并不像在一般自我意识中那样、也不像在自由的自我意识中那样——在那里只是一般的空洞对象，在这里只是从那些在它旁边仍然算数的其他对象那里抽身退回的对象——而是带着对任何别的东西都不存在的意识的对象，是唯一的对象，是一切实在性和当前在场。
但自我意识不仅自为地、而且自在地就是一切实在性，这一点只有通过它成为这种实在性、或者毋宁说通过它把自己表明为这种实在性才成立。
它是在这样一条道路上证明自己的：在这条道路上，首先在意谓、知觉和知性的辩证运动里，他在作为自在的东西消失了，然后在那条通过意识在主人与奴隶中的独立性、通过自由的思想、通过怀疑的解放以及通过自身内分裂的意识的绝对解放之斗争的运动里，他在只要它只是为意识而存在的限度内，对意识自身消失了。
先后出现了两个方面，一方面是本质或真的东西对意识而言具有存在的规定性，另一方面它有的则是只为它而存在的规定性。
但两者都归结为一个真理：存在的东西，或者自在，只有在它为意识而存在的限度内才存在，而它为意识而存在的东西也自在地存在。
具有这一真理的意识把这条道路留在背后，并且已经把它遗忘，因为它直接作为理性出现；或者说，这一直接出现的理性只是作为那个真理的确定性而出现。
它这样只是断言自己是一切实在性，但自己并不以概念把握这一点；因为那条被遗忘的道路就是对这一直接说出的主张的概念把握。
同样，对于没有走过这条道路的人来说，这一主张，当他以这种纯粹的形式听到它时——因为在具体的形态中他自己大概也会作出这一主张——是不可理解的。

en: The idealism that does not set forth that path but begins with this assertion is therefore also pure assurance, which does not comprehend itself nor can make itself intelligible to others.
It expresses an immediate certainty, over against which stand other immediate certainties, which have been lost only on that path.
With equal right, therefore, alongside the assurance of that certainty there also stand the assurances of these other certainties.
Reason appeals to the self-consciousness of every consciousness: I am I, my object and essence is I, and none will deny this truth to it.
But in founding it on this appeal, it sanctions the truth of the other certainty, namely that there is an other for me.
An other than I is object and essence to me, or, in that I am object and essence to myself, I am so only in that I withdraw from the other in general and step as an actuality alongside it.

— Only when reason appears as reflection out of this opposed certainty does its assertion of itself appear not only as certainty and assurance but as truth; and not alongside others, but as the only one.
The immediate appearance is the abstraction of its being-at-hand, whose essence and being-in-itself is the absolute concept, i.e. the movement of its having-become.
— Consciousness will determine its relation to otherness, or to its object, in different ways, according as it stands at a stage of the world-spirit becoming conscious of itself.
How it each time immediately finds and determines itself and its object, or how it is for itself, depends on what it has already become or what it already is in itself.
zh: 那种不陈述那条道路、而是从这一主张开始的观念论，因此也只是纯粹的断言，它既不以概念把握自己，也不能使自己为别人所理解。
它说出一种直接的确定性，而与它相对立的是另一些直接的确定性，这些确定性只有在那条道路上才失去了。
所以，凭借同样的权利，与那种确定性的断言并列，也出现了这些别的确定性的断言。
理性诉诸每一个意识的自我意识：我就是我，我的对象和本质就是我，谁也不会对它否认这一真理。
但就在它把这一点建立在这种诉诸之上时，它也就认可了另一种确定性的真理，即：有他物为我而存在。
与我不同的他物对我来说是对象和本质，或者，在我对自己是对象和本质时，我之所以如此，只是因为我从一般意义上的他物那里抽身退回，并作为一种现实性站到它旁边。
——只有当理性作为反思从这种对立的确定性中出现时，它关于自己的主张才不只是作为确定性和断言、而是作为真理出现；并且不是与其他真理并列，而是作为唯一的真理。
直接的出现是它的现成存在的抽象，这种现成存在的本质和自在存在就是绝对概念，即它已经生成的运动。
——意识将依它恰好站在正在意识到自身的世界精神的哪一个阶段上，以不同的方式规定自己与他在、或与自己的对象的关系。
它每一次如何直接地找到并规定自己和自己的对象，或者说它如何自为地存在，取决于它已经成为了什么，或者它已经自在地是什么。

en: Reason is the certainty of being all reality.
But this in-itself, or this reality, is still something wholly universal, the pure abstraction of reality.
It is the first positivity, which self-consciousness is in itself, for itself, and the I is therefore only the pure essentiality of what is existent, or the simple category.

The category, which otherwise had the meaning of being the essentiality of what is existent, indeterminate whether of what is existent in general or of what is existent over against consciousness, is now the essentiality or simple unity of what is existent only as thinking actuality; or it is this, that self-consciousness and being are the same essence; the same not in comparison, but in and for itself.
Only one-sided, bad idealism again lets this unity step onto one side as consciousness and, over against it, an in-itself.

— But this category, or simple unity of self-consciousness and being, has difference in itself; for its essence is precisely this, to be immediately equal to itself in otherness, or in absolute difference.
The difference therefore is, but it is completely transparent, and as a difference that is at the same time none.
It appears as a multiplicity of categories.

In that idealism expresses the simple unity of self-consciousness as all reality and makes it immediately into the essence, without having comprehended it as absolutely negative essence — only this has negation, determinacy, or difference on itself — this second is even more incomprehensible than the first, namely that in the category there are differences or kinds.

This assurance in general, as well as the assurance of any determinate number of the kinds of the same, is a new assurance, but it contains in itself that one must no longer put up with it as an assurance.
For in that difference begins in the pure I, in pure understanding itself, it is thereby posited that here immediacy, assuring and finding, is given up and comprehending begins.

But to take up the multiplicity of the categories again in some way as a find, for example out of the judgments, and to put up with them in that way, is in fact to be regarded as a disgrace of science; where should understanding still be able to show a necessity, if it is not capable of this in itself, in pure necessity?
zh: 理性是确定性，即它是一切实在性。
但这个自在，或者说这个实在性，还完全是普遍的东西，是实在性的纯粹抽象。
这是第一种肯定性，自我意识自在地、自为地就是它，而“我”因此只是存在者的纯粹本质性，或者说是那个简单的范畴。
范畴过去的意义是充当存在者的本质性，并没有确定这存在者是存在者一般、还是与意识相对的存在者，现在它只是作为思维着的现实性的存在者的本质性或简单统一；或者说，它就是这一点：自我意识和存在是同一个本质；这同一个东西不是在比较中，而是自在自为地是同一个东西。
只有片面的、坏的观念论才又让这种统一作为意识落到一边，并在它对面放上一个自在。
——但这个范畴，或者说自我意识和存在的简单统一，自在地就具有差别；因为它的本质恰恰就是这一点：在他在中，或者在绝对的差别中，直接地与自己相同一。
所以差别是存在的，但它完全透明，而且是这样一种差别：它同时又不是差别。
它显现为范畴的杂多。
观念论把自我意识的简单统一说成一切实在性，并且在还没有把它作为绝对否定的本质——只有这种本质才在自身那里具有否定、规定性或差别——来以概念把握的情况下，就把它直接当成本质，那么这第二点，即范畴中竟有差别或种类，就比第一点更加不可理解。
这种一般性的保证，以及关于这些种类的某个确定数目的保证，是一种新的保证，但它自身就包含着这一点：人们不必再把它当作保证来接受。
因为差别在纯粹的我中、在纯粹知性本身中开始出现，这也就设定了：在这里，直接性、保证和发现都被放弃，而以概念把握开始了。
但是，把范畴的杂多又以某种方式当作现成的发现，例如从判断中拿来，并且就这样接受下来，这实际上必须看作科学的一种耻辱；如果知性在它自身、在纯粹必然性那里都做不到这一点，它还能在哪里指出一种必然性呢？

en: Since in this way the pure essentiality of things, as well as their difference, belongs to reason, there properly could no longer be any talk of things at all, that is, of something that would be for consciousness only the negative of itself.
For the many categories are kinds of the pure category, means: it is still their genus or essence, not opposed to them.
But they are already the ambiguous, which at the same time has in itself otherness over against the pure category in its multiplicity.
They do in fact contradict it through this multiplicity, and the pure unity must sublate them in itself, whereby it constitutes itself as negative unity of the differences.

But as negative unity it excludes from itself both the differences as such and that first immediate pure unity as such, and is individuality, a new category, which is excluding consciousness, that is, this: that an other is for it.

Individuality is its transition from its concept to an external reality, the pure schema, which is just as much consciousness as, in that it is individuality and excluding one, a pointing to an other.

But this other of this category is only the other first categories, namely pure essentiality and pure difference, and in it, that is, precisely in the being-posited of the other, or in this other itself, consciousness is likewise itself; each of these different moments refers to an other; but in them it at the same time comes to no otherness.

The pure category refers to the kinds, which pass over into the negative category or individuality; the latter, however, refers back to those: it is itself pure consciousness, which in each remains this clear unity with itself, but a unity that is likewise pointed to an other, which, in being, has vanished and, in having vanished, is again produced.
zh: 既然这样一来，物的纯粹本质性以及它们的差别都属于理性，那么本来根本就再也不能说到物了，也就是说，再也不能说到这样一种东西：它对意识来说只是它自身的否定物。
因为众多范畴是纯粹范畴的种类，意思是说：纯粹范畴还是它们的属或本质，并没有与它们相对立。
但它们已经是那种双义的东西，它同时自在地具有针对纯粹范畴的他在，而且是在它的杂多中的他在。
通过这种杂多，它们实际上与纯粹范畴相矛盾，而纯粹统一必须在自身中扬弃它们，由此它就把自己建构为诸差别的否定的统一。
但作为否定的统一，它既把那些差别本身、也把那个最初的直接的、纯粹的统一本身，都从自己那里排除出去，并且它就是个别性，是一个新的范畴，而这个范畴是排斥性的意识，也就是说，这就是：有一个他者是为它而存在的。
个别性是它从自己的概念向一种外在实在性的过渡，是纯粹的图式，这个图式既是意识，又由于它是个别性、是排斥性的一，所以也是对一个他者的指向。
但这个范畴的这个他者只是那些最初的其他范畴，即纯粹本质性和纯粹差别，而在它之中，也就是说，恰恰在他者被设定这一点上，或者在这个他者本身之中，意识同样就是它自己；这些不同环节中的每一个都指向另一个；但在它们之中，同时并不产生任何他在。
纯粹范畴指向那些种类，这些种类过渡为否定的范畴或个别性；但后者又反过来指向它们：它本身就是纯粹意识，它在每一个中始终保持这种与自己的清晰统一，但这又是一种同样被指向一个他者的统一，而这个他者存在着就已经消失，消失了就又重新被产生出来。

en: We see pure consciousness here posited in a doubled way, on the one hand as the restless going back and forth, which runs through all its moments, has otherness hovering before it in them, which sublates itself in the grasping; on the other hand rather as the calm unity certain of its truth.
For this unity that movement is the other, for this movement, however, that calm unity; and consciousness and object alternate in these mutual determinations.

Consciousness is thus on the one hand the going back and forth searching and its object the pure in-itself and essence; on the other hand that searching is for it the simple category and the object the movement of the differences.

But consciousness as essence is this whole course itself, to pass over from itself as simple category into individuality and the object, and to intuit this course on that object, to sublate it as a differentiated one, to appropriate it to itself, and to express itself as this certainty, all reality, to be both itself and its object.
zh: 我们在这里看到纯粹意识被以双重方式设定：一方面是不安地来回走动，它遍历自己所有的环节，在这些环节中让他在浮现于眼前，而这个他在在把握中扬弃自己；另一方面则毋宁是那种平静的、确信自己真理的统一。
对这种统一来说，那个运动是他者，而对那个运动来说，这种平静的统一是他者；而意识和对象在这些相互的规定中交替。
所以，意识一方面是那种来回走动的寻找，而它的对象是纯粹的自在和本质；另一方面，这种寻找对它来说就是简单的范畴，而对象则是诸差别的运动。
但作为本质的意识本身就是这整个进程：从作为简单范畴的自己过渡到个别性和对象，并在对象上直观这整个进程，把它作为一个有差别的东西加以扬弃，把它据为己有，并且把自己表达为这种确定性：自己是全部实在性，既是它自己、又是它的对象。

en: Its first utterance is only this abstract empty word, that everything is its own.
For the certainty of being all reality is at first the pure category.

Empty idealism expresses this first reason that cognizes itself in the object, which grasps reason only as it is for itself at first, and in that it shows this pure “mine” of consciousness in all being and expresses things as sensations or representations, imagines it has shown it as consummate reality.

It must therefore at the same time be absolute empiricism, for for the fulfilment of the empty “mine”, that is, for the difference and all development and shaping of it, its reason needs a foreign impulse, in which alone the manifoldness of sensation or representation is supposed to lie.

This idealism therefore becomes just such a self-contradictory ambiguity as scepticism, only that, as the latter expresses itself negatively, the former expresses itself positively, but it just as little brings together its contradictory thoughts of pure consciousness as all reality and likewise of the foreign impulse or of sensuous sensation and representation as an equal reality, but throws itself over and back from the one to the other and has fallen into the bad, namely the sensuous, infinity.

In that reason has all reality in the meaning of the abstract “mine”, and the other is for it an indifferent foreign thing, there is thereby posited precisely that knowing of reason of an other which came up as meaning, perceiving, and the understanding that comprehends what is meant and perceived.
That such a knowing is not true knowing is at the same time asserted through the concept of this idealism itself; for only the unity of apperception is the truth of knowing.

The pure reason of this idealism is thus, through itself, in order to arrive at this other, which is essential to it, that is, is the in-itself, which however it does not have within itself, sent back to that knowing which is not a knowing of the true; it thus condemns itself with knowledge and will to an untrue knowing and cannot let go of meaning and perceiving, which for itself has no truth.

It finds itself in immediate contradiction, to assert a doubled, absolutely opposed [thing] as the essence, the unity of apperception and likewise the thing, which, even if it is called foreign impulse or empirical essence or sensuousness or the thing in itself, in its concept remains the same foreign [thing] to that unity.
zh: 它的第一次说出的话，只是这个抽象空洞的词：一切东西都是它自己的。
因为确信自己是一切实在性这种确定性，最初还只是纯粹范畴。
这种最初在对象中认识自己的理性，是由空洞的观念论表达出来的，这种观念论只把理性理解成它最初对自己所是的样子，并且以为，由于它在一切存在中都指出意识这种纯粹的意谓，把物说成感觉或表象，它就已经把理性指出为完成了的实在性。
因此它同时必然是绝对的经验论，因为要充实那空洞的意谓，也就是说，要充实意谓的差别以及它的全部发展和形态化，它的理性就需要一种外来的刺激，而只有在这种刺激中，感觉或表象的杂多才存在。
因此这种观念论就变成和怀疑论一样的一种自相矛盾的双义性，只不过怀疑论是否定地表达自己，而这种观念论是肯定地表达自己，但它同样不能把自己那些矛盾的思想，即纯粹意识是一切实在性、以及外来的刺激或感性的感觉和表象是同一种实在性，结合起来，而是在两者之间来回抛掷自己，陷入了坏的、也就是感性的无限性。
由于理性把一切实在性都当作抽象的意谓，而他者对理性来说是无所谓的外来之物，那么这里恰好就设定了理性对一个他者的那种知识，这种知识曾经作为意谓、知觉和把握被意谓者与被知觉者的知性出现过。
这样的知识不是真的知识，这一点同时是由这种观念论自己的概念所断言的；因为只有统觉的统一才是知识的真理。
这种观念论的纯粹理性于是通过它自己，为了达到这个他者——这个他者对它是本质性的，也就是说，就是自在，但它并不在自己内部拥有这个自在——而被退回到那种不是关于真的东西的知识上去；它于是凭知识和意志把自己判决给一种不真的知识，并且不能放弃那种对它自己来说没有真理的意谓和知觉。
它处于直接的矛盾之中：它把一种双重的、绝对对立的东西断言为本质，即统觉的统一，以及同样那个物——这个物即使被称为外来的刺激、经验性的本质、感性或物自身，在它的概念中对于那个统一来说仍然是同一个外来之物。

en: This idealism is caught in this contradiction, because it asserts the abstract concept of reason as the true; hence for it reality immediately arises as something that is rather not the reality of reason, while reason at the same time should be all reality; this remains a restless seeking, which in the seeking itself declares the satisfaction of finding to be absolutely impossible.

— But actual reason is not so inconsistent; rather, only as the certainty of being all reality is it in this concept conscious of itself, namely as certainty, as I, of not yet being reality in truth, and it is driven to raise its certainty to truth and to fill the empty meaning.
zh: 这种观念论处在这一矛盾之中，因为它把理性的抽象概念说成真的东西；因此对它来说，实在性立刻就同样产生出来，成为一种反倒不是理性的实在性的东西，而理性同时又应当是全部实在性；这始终是一种不安的寻找，它在寻找本身之中就宣称，找到的满足是绝对不可能的。
——但现实的理性并没有这样前后不一；它在这个概念里只是首先意识到自己是“成为全部实在性”这一确定性，即作为确定性、作为我，它还没有真正地是实在性，并且它被驱使着把自己的确定性提升为真理，去充实那空洞的意谓。

en: This consciousness, for which being has the meaning of its own, we now indeed see again entering into meaning and perceiving, but not as into the certainty of a merely other, rather with the certainty of being this other itself.
Earlier it merely happened to it to perceive and to experience various things on the thing —; here it itself undertakes the observations and the experience.

Meaning and perceiving, which earlier had sublated themselves for us, is now sublated by consciousness for itself; reason sets out to know the truth, to find as concept what a thing is for meaning and perceiving, that is, to have in thinghood only the consciousness of itself.
Reason therefore now has a universal interest in the world, because it is the certainty of having presence in it, or that presence is rational.
It seeks its other in that it knows it possesses therein nothing other than itself; it seeks only its own infinity.
zh: 这种意识，对它来说存在具有属于它自己的意义，我们现在虽然又看到它走进意谓和知觉，但不是走进一个仅仅是他者的东西的确定性，而是带着自己就是这个他者本身的确定性。
早先它只是碰上这样的事，即在物身上知觉到并经验到某些东西——；在这里，它自己着手进行观察和经验。
意谓和知觉，早先在我们这里已经扬弃了自己，现在则被意识为它自己而扬弃；理性着眼于知道真理，把在意谓和知觉看来一个物是什么当作概念来找到，也就是说，在物性中只拥有对它自己的意识。
因此理性现在对世界有一种普遍的关切，因为它是这样的确定性：在世界中有在场，或者说在场是合乎理性的。
它寻找它的他者，同时知道自己在他者那里除了它自己什么也不拥有；它寻找的只是它自己的无限性。

en: At first only divining itself in actuality, or knowing it only as its own in general, it proceeds in this sense to the universal taking possession of the property assured to it, and plants on all heights and in all depths the sign of its sovereignty.
But this superficial meaning is not its ultimate interest; the joy of this universal taking possession still finds on its property the alien other, which abstract reason does not have in itself.

Reason divines itself as a deeper essence, for it is the pure I and must demand that difference, manifold being, become for it its very own, that it intuit itself as actuality and find itself present as shape and thing.

But if reason rummages through all the entrails of things and opens all their veins, so that it may spring out of them toward itself, it will not attain this happiness; rather it must first have completed itself in itself, in order then to be able to experience its completion.
zh: 起初它在现实性中只是预感到自己，或者只是把现实性一般地认作属于自己的东西，它就在这个意义上走向对已经向它保证的财产的普遍占有，并把它的主权标志插上所有的高处、植入所有的深处。
但这种肤浅的意谓并不是它最终的兴趣；这种普遍占有的快乐在它的财产那里还碰到陌生的他者，而抽象理性并不在自己身上拥有这个他者。
理性预感到自己是一种更深的本质，因为它就是纯粹的自我，并且必须要求差别、那多样的存在成为它自己的东西，要求它把自己直观为现实性，发现自己作为形态和物而当下在场。
但如果理性翻遍物的所有内脏，为它们打开所有血管，好让自己从其中迎面跳出来，那它并不会达到这种幸福，而是必须先在自己身上完成自己，然后才能经验到自己的完成。

en: Consciousness observes, that is, reason wants to find and have itself as an existing object, as an actual, sensuously present mode.
The consciousness of this observing does indeed mean and say that it wants to experience not itself but, on the contrary, the essence of things as of things.
That this consciousness means and says this lies in the fact that it is reason, but that reason is not yet an object to it as such.

If it knew reason as the same essence of things and of itself, and that reason can be present in its own proper shape only in consciousness, it would rather descend into its own depth and seek it there than in things.
If it had found it in this depth, it would from there be directed out again to actuality, in order to intuit in it its sensuous expression, but would immediately take this essentially as concept.

Reason, as it immediately appears as the certainty of consciousness of being all reality, takes its reality in the sense of the immediacy of being, and likewise the unity of the I with this objective essence in the sense of an immediate unity, in which it has not yet separated and again united the moments of being and of the I, or which it has not yet cognized.

It therefore, as observing consciousness, goes to things, in the opinion that it takes them in truth as sensuous things opposed to the I; but its actual doing contradicts this opinion, for it cognizes things, it transforms their sensuousness into concepts, that is, precisely into a being that is at the same time I, thus thinking into an existing thinking or being into a thought being, and it asserts in fact that things have truth only as concepts.

For this observing consciousness, what comes out therein is only what things are, but for us what it itself is; the result of its movement, however, will be that it becomes for itself what it is in itself.
zh: 意识在观察，也就是说，理性想要把自己当作存在着的对象、当作现实的、感性当下在场的样式来找到并拥有。
这种观察的意识确实意谓并且说，它想要经验的不是它自己，恰恰相反，是物之为物的本质。
这种意识之所以这样意谓、这样说，原因在于它是理性，但理性对它来说还不是作为理性而成为对象。
如果它把理性认作物和它自身共有的同一本质，并且知道理性只有在意识中才能以其特有的形态当下在场，那么它反倒会深入自己的深处，在那里寻找理性，而不是在物中寻找。
如果它在这种深处找到了理性，理性就会从那里重新被指向现实性，以便在现实性中直观自己的感性表达，但它又会立刻把这种表达本质上当作概念来对待。
理性直接作为意识之成为全部实在性的确定性而出现时，是在存在的直接性这一意义上来理解自己的实在性，同样也是在一种直接统一的意义上来理解自我与这种对象性本质的统一，在这种统一中它还没有把存在和自我的环节分开又重新结合起来，或者说还没有认识到这种统一。
因此它作为观察的意识走向物，带着这样的意谓：它真地是把这些物当作感性的、与自我相对立的物来把握的；但它的实际做法却与这种意谓相矛盾，因为它认识物，它把物的感性转化为概念，也就是转化为一种同时是自我的存在，从而把思维转化为存在着的思维，或者把存在转化为被思维的存在，并且实际上断言，物只有作为概念才具有真理。
对观察的意识来说，其中出现的结果只是物是什么；而对我们来说，则是它自己是什么；但它这一运动的结果将会是：它自为地成为它自在所是的东西。

en: The doing of observing reason is to be considered in the moments of its movement, how it takes up nature, spirit, and finally the relation of both as sensuous being, and seeks itself as existing actuality.
zh: 观察的理性的做法要在其运动的各个环节中来考察：它如何把自然、精神以及最后把两者的关系当作感性存在接受下来，并把自己当作存在着的现实性来寻找。

en: When thoughtless consciousness declares observing and experiencing to be the source of truth, its words may well sound as if it were concerned solely with tasting, smelling, feeling, hearing and seeing; in the zeal with which it recommends tasting, smelling, etc., it forgets to say that in fact it has likewise just as essentially already determined for itself the object of this sensing, and that this determination counts for it at least as much as that sensing.

It will also at once admit that it is not concerned merely with perceiving in general, and will, for example, not let the perception that this penknife lies beside this snuffbox count as an observation.
The perceived should at least have the meaning of a universal, not of a sensuous this.
zh: 当无思想的意识把观察和经验说成真理的来源时，它的话听起来也许就像只关乎尝味、嗅味、触感、听和看；在它推荐尝味、嗅味等等的那股热忱中，它忘了说，它实际上同样本质地已经为自己规定了这种感觉的对象，而且这种规定对它的分量至少不低于那种感觉。
它也会马上承认，它并不只是一般地要知觉，并且比如不会把“这把小刀放在这个烟盒旁边”这一知觉当作观察。
被知觉到的东西至少应当具有普遍之物的意义，而不是一个感性的这一个的意义。

en: This universal is thus at first only the self-same; its movement only the uniform return of the same doing.

Consciousness, which in this respect finds in the object only universality or the abstract meaning, must take upon itself the proper movement of the object, and, since it is not yet the understanding of it, must at least be its memory, which expresses in a universal way what is present in actuality only in a singular way.

This superficial lifting out of singularity, and the equally superficial form of universality into which the sensuous is merely taken up without itself having become universal — the describing of things — still does not have the movement in the object itself; the movement is rather only in the describing.
The object, as it is described, has therefore lost interest; if one has been described, another must be taken up and ever sought anew, so that the describing does not run out.

If it is no longer so easy to find new whole things, one must go back to those already found, in order to divide them further, to lay them apart, and to trace out in them still new sides of thinghood.

This restless, uneasy instinct can never lack material; to find a new distinguished genus, or even a new planet, which, although it is an individual, still has the nature of a universal, can fall only to the fortunate.

But the boundary of what, like the elephant, the oak, the gold, is distinguished, what is genus and species, passes through many stages over into the infinite particularization of the chaotic animals and plants, of the mountain kinds, or of the metals, earths, etc. that are first to be presented through violence and art.

In this realm of the indeterminacy of the universal, in which particularization again approaches singularization and here and there also descends wholly into it, an inexhaustible store is opened up for observing and describing.

Here, however, where a boundless field opens up before it, at the boundary of the universal, it can rather, instead of an immeasurable wealth, have found only the limit of nature and of its own doing; it can no longer know whether what seems to be in itself is not an accident; what bears the stamp of a confused or immature, weak formation that has hardly developed out of elementary indeterminacy cannot claim even to be described.
zh: 这种普遍之物因此首先只是自身保持不变的东西；它的运动也只是同一种做法的均匀重复。
就此而言在对象中只找到普遍性或者说抽象意谓的意识，必须把对象自身的运动承担起来，并且，由于它还不是对象的知性，它至少必须做对象的记忆，这种记忆以普遍的方式道出在现实性中只以个别方式存在的东西。
这种从个别性中作出的肤浅抽取，以及感性之物只是被纳入其中、而它自身还没有成为普遍之物这一同样肤浅的普遍性形式，也就是对物的描述，在对象本身那里还没有运动；运动反倒只存在于描述之中。
因此，对象在被描述出来的样子中已经失去了兴趣；一个被描述完了，就必须另取一个，并且总要找新的，好让描述不至于中断。
如果不再那么容易找到新的整全的物，那就必须回到已经找到的物那里，把它们进一步划分、拆解开来，并在它们身上再探查出物性的新侧面。
这种不知疲倦、不得安宁的本能永远不会缺少材料；要发现一个新的出众的属，或者甚至发现一颗新的行星——它虽然是个体，却具有普遍之物的本性——，这种运气只能落到幸运者头上。
但是，像大象、橡树、黄金那样出众的东西、是属和种的东西，其界限经过许多阶段，过渡到混沌的动物和植物、各种山岩、或者只有靠暴力和技艺才呈现出来的金属、泥土等等的无限特殊化之中。
在这普遍之物之无规定性的王国里，特殊化又重新靠近个别化，并且在这里那里又完全降入个别化之中，对观察和描述来说，这里展开了一份取之不尽的储备。
但在这里，在普遍之物的边界上，当一片望不到边的田野向它展开时，它反倒可能不是发现无法度量的财富，而只是发现自然和它自己所作所为的界限；它再也无法知道，那显得自在存在的东西是不是一种偶然；凡是带有混乱的或未成熟的、软弱的、几乎还没有从元素式的无规定性中发展出来的形态的印记的东西，都不能要求哪怕只是被描述。

en: If this seeking and describing seems to be concerned only with the things, we nevertheless see that in fact it does not run on along sensuous perceiving; rather, that by which the things are cognized is more important to it than the remaining range of sensuous properties, which the thing itself surely cannot do without, but which consciousness does without.

Through this distinction into the essential and the inessential, the concept rises up out of sensuous dispersion, and cognition declares therein that it is at least as essential to it to be concerned with itself as with the things.
In this doubled essentiality it falls into a wavering as to whether what is the essential and necessary for cognition is also so in the things.

On the one hand, the marks are supposed to serve only cognition, whereby it distinguishes the things from one another; but on the other hand, it is not the inessential in the things that is to be cognized, but that whereby the things themselves tear themselves loose from the general continuity of being as such, separate themselves from the other and are for themselves.

The marks are supposed to have not only an essential relation to cognition but also to be the essential determinacies of the things, and the artificial system is supposed to accord with the system of nature itself and only to express this.

From the concept of reason this is necessary, and the instinct of reason — for in this observing it behaves only as such — has also in its systems attained this unity, where namely its objects themselves are so constituted that they have an essentiality or a being-for-itself in them and are not merely the accident of this moment or of this here.

The distinguishing marks of animals, for example, are taken from claws and teeth; for in fact it is not only cognition that thereby distinguishes one animal from another, but the animal itself thereby separates itself off; through these weapons it maintains itself for itself and separated from the universal.

The plant, by contrast, does not arrive at being-for-itself, but only touches the boundary of individuality; at this boundary, where it displays the semblance of a division into sexes, it has therefore been taken up and distinguished.
But what stands further down can no longer distinguish itself from another, but is lost as it enters into opposition.

Resting being and being in relation come into strife with each other; the thing is in this something other than according to that, whereas the individual is this: to maintain itself in relation to another.

But what is not capable of this and in a chemical way becomes something other than it is in an empirical way confuses cognition and brings it into the same strife as to whether it should hold to the one side or the other, since the thing itself is nothing self-same and they fall apart in it.
zh: 如果说这种寻找和描述看来只关涉到物，那么我们实际上看到，它并不是沿着感性知觉往前走的；相反，物凭以被认识到的东西，对它来说比感性属性的其余范围更重要，这些感性属性诚然是物自身少不了的东西，但意识却可以省掉它们。
通过这种对本质之物和非本质之物的区分，概念从感性的分散中升了起来，而认识在其中声明：对它来说，至少同样本质地关涉到它自己，也关涉到物。
在这种双重的本质性上，它陷入一种摇摆：对认识来说本质的和必然的东西，是否在物那里也是本质的和必然的。
一方面，标志只应当为认识服务，认识凭标志把物彼此区分开来；但另一方面，要被认识的不是物身上非本质的东西，而是物本身凭以从存在一般的普遍连续性中挣脱出来、从它者那里分离出来并自为地存在的东西。
标志不应当只具有对认识的本质关系，而且应当也是物的本质规定性，而人为的系统应当符合自然本身的系统，并且只表达这个系统。
从理性的概念来看，这是必然的，而理性的本能——因为在这种观察中，它只是作为本能而行事——也在它的各种系统里达到了这种统一，即在其中它的对象本身就是这样构成的：它们在自身那里有一种本质性或者一种自为存在，而不只是这个瞬间或这个这里的偶然事情。
例如动物的区分标志取自爪和牙；因为实际上不只是认识凭这些把一个动物和另一个动物区分开来，而是动物自己凭这些把自己分离出来；凭这些武器，它为自己、并与普遍的东西分离开来而维持自身。
相反，植物并没有达到自为存在，而只是触及个体性的边界；在这个边界上，它显示出分裂为性别的假象，因此它才被纳入进来并被区分开来。
但更下面的东西，再也不能自己把自己和别的东西区分开来，而是在进入对立时就消失了。
静止的存在和处在关系中的存在彼此陷入争执，物在这种关系中与按照那种存在时不同，与此相反，个体却是这样：在与他物的关系中维持自身。
但做不到这一点、并且以化学的方式成为不同于它在经验中的样子的东西，会使认识混乱，并把认识带入同样的争执：它究竟应当抓住这一面还是另一面，因为物本身不是某种保持不变的东西，而那两面在它身上互相分离。

en: In such systems of the generally self-same, this therefore has the meaning of being just as much the self-same of cognition as of the things themselves.

But this spreading out of the self-same determinacies, each of which calmly describes the series of its progression and receives space in order to hold sway for itself, passes essentially just as much over into its opposite, into the confusion of these determinacies; for the mark, the universal determinacy, is the unity of the opposed, of the determinate and of the in-itself universal; it must therefore fall apart into this opposition.

If now the determinacy on one side defeats the universal in which it has its essence, then on the other side the universal likewise secures its dominion over it, drives the determinacy to its limit, and there mixes up its differences and essentialities.

Observing, which held them neatly apart and believed it had something firm in them, sees one principle reaching over into the others, transitions and confusions forming, and in this sees connected what it first took as absolutely separate, and separate what it counted together; so that this holding fast to the calm, self-same being must here see itself mocked, precisely in its most general determinacies, for example as to what essential marks the animal, the plant has, by instances that rob it of every determinacy, reduce the universality to which it had raised itself to silence, and set it back to thoughtless observing and describing.
zh: 所以在普遍的自相同者的这类系统里，这种自相同者就具有这样的意义：它既是认识的自相同者，也是物自身的自相同者。
但这些保持不变的规定性的这种铺展，其中每一个规定性都安静地描述着自己进展的序列、并获得空间以便自为地起作用，本质上同样也过渡到它的对立面，即过渡到这些规定性的混乱；因为标志、即普遍的规定性，是对立之物、被规定之物和自在的普遍之物的统一；所以它必然分裂为这种对立。
现在，如果规定性在一方面战胜了它于其中拥有自己本质的普遍之物，那么普遍之物在另一方面同样保住了它对规定性的统治，把规定性驱赶到它的边界上，并在那里把它的差别和本质性搅在一起。

观察曾经把它们整整齐齐地分开，并且相信在它们身上拥有某种牢固的东西，现在却看到一个原则伸到别的原则上去，看到过渡和混乱形成起来，看到它最初当作绝对分离的东西被联结起来，而它算作一体的东西被分离开来；以致这种对安静地自相同一的存在者的坚持，在这里恰恰在它最普遍的规定里，例如在动物、植物有什么本质标志这一规定里，不得不见到自己被一些实例戏弄，这些实例夺走它每一个规定，让它所升到的普遍性哑口无言，并把它退回到无思想的观察和描述上去。

en: This observing, which restricts itself to the simple or restricts sensuous dispersion through the universal, thus finds in its object the confusion of its principle, because the determinate must by its nature lose itself in its opposite; reason must therefore go on rather from the inert determinacy, which has the semblance of permanence, to the observation of it as it truly is, namely as relating itself to its opposite.

What are called essential marks are resting determinacies which, just as they express themselves and are grasped as simple, do not present what constitutes their nature: to be vanishing moments of the movement that takes itself back into itself.

Now that the instinct of reason comes to seek out the determinacy according to its nature, as essentially not being for itself but passing over into the opposite, it seeks after the law and the concept of this; to be sure, it seeks after them likewise as existent actuality, but this will in fact vanish for it, and the sides of the law will become for it pure moments or abstractions, so that the law emerges in the nature of the concept, which has in itself annihilated the indifferent subsistence of sensuous actuality.
zh: 这种把自己限制在简单之物上、或者凭普遍之物来限制感性分散的观察，于是在自己的对象上发现自己的原则的混乱，因为被规定的东西按其本性必然要在自己的对立面中消失；所以理性倒必须从那种具有持存假象的惰性规定性，前进到对规定性本身的观察，即观察它在真理中是怎样的，也就是观察它与自己的对立面发生关系。
所谓本质标志，是些静止的规定性，它们照它们作为简单之物所表达、所被把握的样子，并不呈现出构成它们本性的东西：即作为那种把自己收回自身的运动的消失着的环节。
现在，既然理性的本能进而要去寻找规定性按其本性即本质上并非自为地存在、而是过渡到对立面这一情况，它就去寻找这件事的规律和概念；诚然它同样把它们当作存在着的现实性来寻找，但这种现实性实际上会对它消失，而规律的各个方面会对它成为纯粹的环节或抽象，以致规律在概念的本性中显现出来，而概念已经在自身中消灭了感性现实性的漠不相关的持存。

en: For observing consciousness the truth of the law is in experience, namely in such a way that sensuous being is for it; not in and for itself.
But if the law does not have its truth in the concept, then it is something contingent, not a necessity, or in fact not a law.
But that it essentially is as concept does not merely not contradict its being present for observation, but on that very account has necessary determinate being and is for observation.

The universal in the sense of universal reason is also universal in the sense that this has for it, namely that for consciousness it presents itself as the present and actual, or that the concept presents itself in the manner of thinghood and of sensuous being — but without thereby losing its nature and having fallen down into inert subsistence or indifferent succession.
What is universally valid is also universally in force; what is supposed to be is in fact also, and what is only supposed to be without being has no truth.

On this the instinct of reason on its side rightly holds fast and does not let itself be led astray by the thought-things that are only supposed to be and are supposed to have truth as an ought, even though they are met with in no experience — no more by hypotheses than by all the other invisibilities of a perennial ought; for reason is precisely this certainty of having reality, and what is not for consciousness as a self-essence, that is, what does not appear, is for it nothing at all.
zh: 对观察的意识来说，规律的真理在经验中，即存在于感性存在是为它而存在这种方式中；而不是自在自为的。
但如果规律不在概念中拥有自己的真理，那么它就是某种偶然的东西，不是一种必然性，或者实际上就不是规律。
但规律本质上作为概念而存在，这不仅不与它为观察而存在相矛盾，反而因此拥有必然的定在，并且是为观察而存在的。
在理性的普遍性这一意义上的普遍之物，也在那种普遍之物于它身上所具有的意义上是普遍的，即它对意识表现为当前的和现实的，或者说，概念以物性和感性存在的方式呈现出来——但并不因此失去自己的本性，也没有堕入惰性的持存或漠不相关的相继之中。
普遍有效的东西，也是普遍生效的；应当存在的东西，实际上也存在，而仅仅应当存在却没有存在的东西，没有真理。
理性的本能在这方面有理由牢牢抓住这一点，并且不让那些仅仅应当存在、并且作为应当而应当拥有真理——尽管它们在任何经验中都遇不到——的思想之物把自己弄糊涂，不论是各种假设，还是某种长存的应当的一切其他看不见的东西；因为理性恰恰就是这种确定性：拥有实在性，而凡不是作为自身本质为意识而存在的东西，也就是凡不显现的东西，对意识来说就根本不算什么。

en: That the truth of the law is essentially reality becomes, to be sure, for this consciousness that remains with observing, again an opposition to the concept and to the in-itself universal; or such a thing as its law is, is not for it an essence of reason; in it, it means to get hold of something alien.

But it refutes this its opinion by the deed, in which it itself does not take its universality in the sense that all individual sensuous things must have shown it the appearance of the law in order for it to be able to assert the truth of the same.

That stones, lifted from the earth and let go, fall — for this it does not at all demand that this experiment be made with all stones; it perhaps does say that this must at least have been tried with very many, from which it can then be concluded to the rest with the greatest probability or with full right according to analogy.
But analogy not only gives no full right, but by its very nature refutes itself so often that, to conclude according to analogy itself, analogy rather permits no inference to be made.

The probability to which the result of the same would be reduced loses, over against the truth, all difference of lesser and greater probability; let it be as great as it will, it is nothing over against the truth.

But the instinct of reason in fact accepts such laws as truth, and only in relation to their necessity, which it does not cognize, does it fall into this distinction and degrade the truth of the matter itself to probability, in order to designate the imperfect manner in which the truth is present for the consciousness that has not yet attained insight into the pure concept; for the universality is present only as simple, immediate universality.

But at the same time, on account of it, the law has truth for consciousness; that the stone falls is therefore true for it because the stone is heavy for it, that is, because in heaviness it has in and for itself the essential relation to the earth, which expresses itself as falling.

Thus it has in experience the being of the law, but likewise the same as concept, and only on account of both circumstances together is it true for it; it therefore counts as law because it presents itself in appearance and at the same time is in itself concept.
zh: 规律的真理本质上就是实在性，这一点虽然对那种停留在观察上的意识来说，又变成一种对概念、对自在的普遍之物的对立；或者说，像它的规律这样的东西，对它来说并不是理性的本质；它以为在这里得到的是某种陌生的东西。
但它的这种行为驳倒了它的这个看法，因为在行为中它自己并没有在这样一种意义上采用自己的普遍性，即所有单个的感性之物都必须向它显示出规律的现象，它才能断言规律的真理。
石头从地面被举起又被放开就下落，对此它根本不要求用所有石头来做这个实验；它也许会说，至少必须用很多石头试过这件事，然后才能由此以最大的或然性、或者以充分的权利按类比推断其余的石头。
但类比不仅不给出充分的权利，而且由于它自己的本性，它是如此经常地驳倒自己，以致如果按类比本身来推断，类比反倒不允许作出任何推论。
类比的结果最后会归结到的那种或然性，在真理面前失去较小或然性和较大或然性之间的一切差别；无论它有多大，它在真理面前都算不了什么。
但理性的本能实际上把这类规律当作真理来接受，只是在与它尚未认识到的规律的必然性的关联中，它才陷入这种区分，并把事情本身的真理降为或然性，以便标明那种还没有达到对纯粹概念的洞见的意识所具有的真理的不完整方式；因为普遍性只是作为简单的、直接的普遍性而存在。
但与此同时，正是由于这种普遍性，规律对意识来说才具有真理；石头下落之所以对它来说是真的，是因为石头对它来说是重的，也就是说，因为石头在重量中自在自为地具有与地球的本质关系，而这种关系表现为下落。
所以它在经验中拥有规律的存在，但同样也把规律当作概念来拥有，并且只有同时凭这两个情况，规律对它来说才是真的；规律之所以算作规律，是因为它在现象中呈现出来，同时又在自身中就是概念。

en: The instinct of reason of this consciousness, because the law is at the same time in itself concept, necessarily goes of itself to purify the law and its moments into the concept, yet without knowing that it wills this.
It institutes experiments on the law.
As the law first appears, it presents itself impurely, wrapped round by singular sensuous being, and the concept that constitutes its nature sunk in empirical material.
In its experiments the instinct of reason aims at finding what takes place under these and those circumstances.
Thereby the law seems only all the more to be dipped into sensuous being; but this is rather lost in the process.

This research has the inner meaning of finding the pure conditions of the law; which means nothing else (even if the consciousness that expresses itself in this way should mean that it thereby says something else) than to raise the law wholly into the shape of the concept and to wipe out all the bondedness of its moments to determinate being.

Negative electricity, for example, which at first perhaps announces itself as resin electricity, just as positive electricity announces itself as glass electricity, entirely loses this meaning through the experiments and becomes purely positive and negative electricity, each of which no longer belongs to a particular kind of thing; and it ceases to be possible to say that there are bodies that are positively electric, others that are negatively electric.
Thus too the relation of acid and base and their movement against one another constitutes a law in which these opposites appear as bodies.
But these separated things have no actuality; the violence that tears them apart cannot prevent them from immediately entering again into a process; for they are only this relation.
They cannot remain for themselves like a tooth or a claw and be exhibited in that way.
That this is their essence, to pass over immediately into a neutral product, makes their being a being sublated in itself or a universal one, and acid and base have truth only as universals.

Just as glass and resin can be positively as well as negatively electric, so acid and base is not bound as a property to this or that actuality, but every thing is only relatively acid or basic; what seems to be a decided base or acid receives in the so-called synsomata the opposite meaning in relation to another.
— The result of the experiments in this way sublates the moments or inspiriting (Begeistungen) as properties of determinate things and frees the predicates from their subjects.

These predicates are found, as they are in truth, only as universal; on account of this independence they therefore receive the name of matters, which are neither bodies nor properties, and one takes good care not to call oxygen and so on, positive and negative electricity, heat and so on, bodies.
zh: 这种意识的理性本能，因为规律同时自在地就是概念，所以自己必然要去把规律及其环节纯化为概念，却并不知道自己意欲这一点。
它对规律做实验。
规律最初出现时，把自己呈现得并不纯粹，被个别的感性存在包裹着，而构成它本性的那个概念则沉没在经验材料之中。
理性本能在它的实验里所要找到的，是在这种或那种情况下会出现什么。
规律由此看来只是越发被浸入感性存在之中；但后者在其中反倒消失了。
这种研究具有的内在含义，是去发现规律的那些纯粹条件；这话要说的不是别的（即使这样表达自己的那种意识以为，它由此说出了什么别的东西），而是把规律完全提升到概念的形态之中，并消除它的各个环节对特定存在的全部束缚。
例如负电，它最初也许作为树脂电出现，正如正电作为玻璃电出现，通过实验就完全失去了这种含义，纯粹变成了正电和负电，而这两者都不再属于某一特殊种类的物；并且不再能够说：有一些物体是带正电的，另一些是带负电的。
同样，酸和碱的关系以及它们彼此相对的运动，也构成一条规律，其中这些对立面是作为物体出现的。
但这些被分离出来的物并没有现实性；把它们撕开的那种暴力，并不能阻止它们立刻又重新进入一个过程；因为它们只是这种关系。
它们不能像牙齿或爪子那样自为地留存下来，并被这样指出来。
它们的本质就是直接过渡为一个中性的产物，这一点使它们的存在成为自在地被扬弃了的存在、或成为普遍的存在，而酸和碱只有作为普遍的东西才有真理。
所以，正如玻璃和树脂既可以是带正电的，也可以是带负电的，酸和碱作为属性也并不绑定于这种或那种现实性，而是每一个物都只是相对地呈酸性或碱性；看起来是确定的碱或酸的东西，在所谓的混合体（Synsomatien）中相对于另一个东西就获得了相反的含义。
——实验的结果就这样扬弃了那些环节或精神化（Begeistungen）作为特定之物的属性，并把诸谓词从它们的诸主体中解放出来。
这些谓词，如同它们在真理中那样，只被当作普遍的东西来发现；由于这种独立性，它们就得到了物质之名，而物质既不是物体也不是属性，人们也小心避免把氧等等、正电和负电、热等等称为物体。

en: Matter, by contrast, is not an existent thing, but being as universal or in the manner of the concept.

Reason, which is still instinct, makes this correct distinction without the consciousness that, in testing the law on all sensuous being, it thereby sublates its merely sensuous being, and that, in taking its moments as matters, their essentiality has become for it the universal and is expressed in this expression as an unsensuous sensuous, as a bodiless and yet objective being.
zh: 相反，物质并不是一个存在着的物，而是作为普遍东西的存在，或者说以概念方式的存在。
还只是本能的理性作出了这种正确的差别，却没有意识到：它在一切感性存在上检验规律时，恰恰就在这一点上扬弃了规律那种仅仅是感性的存在；也没有意识到：当它把规律的诸环节当作物质来把握时，这些环节的本质性对规律来说已经成了普遍的东西，并且在这个说法里被说出为一种非感性的感性之物，一种无物体而又有对象性的存在。

en: It is now to be seen what turn its result takes for it and what new shape of its observing thereby emerges.

As the truth of this experimenting consciousness we see the pure law, which frees itself from sensuous being; we see it as concept that is present in sensuous being, but moves in it independently and unbound, is sunk in it, free of it, and is simple concept.

This, which in truth is the result and the essence, now comes on the scene for this consciousness itself, but as object, and indeed, since it is for it precisely not result and without relation to the preceding movement, as a particular kind of object, and its relation to this as a different observing.
zh: 现在要来看的是：它的结果对它来说会出现怎样的转折，以及它的观察由此会出现怎样的新形态。
作为这种做实验的意识的真理，我们看到的是纯粹规律，它从感性存在中解放出来；我们把它看作概念，这个概念存在于感性存在之中，但在其中独立而不受束缚地运动着，沉没于其中却又不受其束缚，并且是单纯的概念。
这个在真理中既是结果又是本质的东西，现在对这种意识本身出现了，但却是作为对象出现的，而且，正因为它对它来说恰恰不是结果、也没有与先前运动的关系，它就是作为一种特殊种类的对象出现的，而它同这个对象的关系则是作为一种别样的观察出现的。

en: Such an object, which has the process on it in the simplicity of the concept, is the organic.
It is this absolute fluidity, in which the determinacy through which it would be only for another is dissolved.

If the inorganic thing has determinacy as its essence and therefore only together with another thing makes up the completeness of the moments of the concept, and hence is lost when it enters into movement, then on the other hand, in the organic essence, all determinacies through which it is open for another are bound under the organic simple unity; none comes forward as essential that would relate itself freely to another, and the organic therefore maintains itself in its relation itself.
zh: 这种在概念的单纯性中自身具有过程的对象，就是有机的东西。
它就是这种绝对的流动性，在其中，那种会使它仅仅为另一个东西而存在的规定性已被消解。
如果无机的物以规定性为自己的本质，因而只有同一个别的物合在一起才构成概念诸环节的完整性，并因此在进入运动时就消失了，那么相反，对有机的本质来说，一切使它为另一个东西敞开的规定性都束缚在有机的单纯统一之下；没有任何一种规定性是作为本质性的东西出现的，会自由地同另一个东西发生关系，所以有机的东西在它的关系本身中维持着自己。

en: The sides of the law, to whose observation the instinct of reason here proceeds, are, as follows from this determination, at first organic nature and inorganic nature in their relation to one another.

The latter is for the organic precisely the freedom, opposed to its simple concept, of the released determinacies, in which individual nature is at the same time dissolved and from whose continuity it at the same time separates itself and is for itself.

Air, water, earth, zones and climate are such universal elements, which constitute the indeterminate simple essence of individualities and in which these are at the same time reflected into themselves.

Neither individuality is absolutely in and for itself, nor the elemental, but in the independent freedom in which they come forward against one another for observation, they comport themselves at the same time as essential relations, yet in such a way that the independence and indifference of both toward one another is the ruling element and only partly passes over into abstraction.

Here, then, the law is present as the relation of an element to the formation of the organic, which at one time has elemental being over against itself and at another time presents it in its organic reflection.

But such laws — that the animals that belong to the air are of the constitution of birds, those that belong to water of the constitution of fishes, that northern animals have a thick-haired coat, and so on — at once show a poverty that does not correspond to the organic manifoldness.

Besides that organic freedom knows how to withdraw its forms again from these determinations and necessarily offers everywhere exceptions to such laws or rules, as one might want to call them, this remains, even in those that fall under them, so superficial a determination that even the expression of its necessity cannot be otherwise and does not get beyond a great influence; and here one does not know what actually belongs to this influence and what does not.

Such relations of the organic to the elemental are therefore in fact not to be called laws; for on the one hand, as recalled, such a relation does not at all exhaust the extent of the organic as regards its content, and on the other hand the moments of the relation themselves also remain indifferent to one another and express no necessity.

In the concept of acid lies the concept of base, as in the concept of positive electricity lies negative electricity; but however much the thick-haired coat may be found together with the north, or the structure of fishes with water, the structure of birds with air, the concept of thick hair does not lie in the concept of the north, that of the structure of fishes not in that of the sea, that of the structure of birds not in that of the air.
On account of this freedom of both sides over against each other there are also land animals that have the essential characters of a bird, of the fish, and so on.
Necessity, because it cannot be comprehended as an inner one of essence, also ceases to have sensuous determinate being, and can no longer be observed on actuality, but has stepped out of it.
Not finding itself thus on the real essence itself, it is what is called teleological relation, a relation that is external to the related terms and is therefore rather the opposite of a law.
It is the thought wholly freed from necessary nature, which leaves it and moves for itself above it.
zh: 这种规律的各个方面，理性本能在这里所要观察的正是这种规律，正如从这一规定中得出的那样，首先是有机自然界和无机自然界在它们彼此关系中的情形。
后一方面对有机自然界来说，恰恰就是那些被松脱开的规定性的自由，这种自由与它的单纯概念相对立，个体的本性同时消解在这些规定性之中，并且从它们的连续性中同时把自己分离出来，自为地存在着。
空气、水、土、地带和气候就是这样一些普遍的元素，它们构成诸个体性的无规定的单纯本质，而诸个体性同时又在其中被反思回自身。
无论个体性还是元素性的东西，都不是绝对自在自为的，而是在它们为观察而彼此相对出现的那种独立的自由中，它们同时又是作为本质性的关系而相互对待的，但情形是这样：两者彼此之间的独立性和漠不相关是占主导的东西，并且只是部分地过渡为抽象。
所以在这里，规律是作为一个元素对有机东西之形成的关系而存在的，有机的东西时而把元素性的存在作为对立面与自己相对，时而又在它的有机反思中把这种存在展示出来。
但是，这样一些规律，即属于空气的动物具有鸟的性状、属于水的动物具有鱼的性状、北方的动物长着厚毛的皮，等等，立刻就显露出一种贫乏，这种贫乏与有机的多样性并不相称。
且不说有机的自由懂得把自己的形式重新从这些规定那里收回，并且必然到处都提供出这样一些规律或人们想称之为规则的东西的例外，就是在那些从属于它们的东西身上，这仍然是一种如此表面的规定，以至于连它的必然性的说法也只能是那个样子，超不出“巨大影响”之外；而在这里，人们并不知道什么才真正属于这种影响，什么不属于。
所以，有机的东西对元素性东西的这类关系，实际上根本不能叫做规律；因为一方面，正如已经回想到的，这样一种关系按其内容来说根本没有穷尽有机的东西的范围，另一方面，关系本身的那些环节也依然彼此漠不相关，并没有表达出任何必然性。
在酸的概念里包含着碱的概念，正如在正电的概念里包含着负电的概念；但尽管厚毛的皮与北方、鱼的结构与水、鸟的结构与空气可以一起碰到，北方这个概念里却并不包含厚毛的概念，海洋这个概念里并不包含鱼的结构的概念，空气这个概念里并不包含鸟的结构的概念。
由于两个方面彼此相对的这种自由，也就有了一些陆地动物，它们具有鸟、鱼的本质特征，等等。
必然性，由于它不能被以概念把握为本质的内在东西，也就不再有感性的定在，不能再在现实性上被观察，而是已经走出了现实性。
它这样在实在的本质本身那里找不到自己，于是它就是那种被称为目的论关系的东西，一种对相关双方来说外在的关系，因此毋宁说是规律的反面。
它是完全从必然的自然中解放出来的思想，这种思想离开了自然，并在自然之上自为地运动着。

en: If the relation of the organic to elementary nature touched on just before does not express the essence of the organic, it is on the other hand contained in the concept of end.
To this observing consciousness, to be sure, it is not the organic's own essence, but falls for it outside the organic, and is then only that external, teleological relation.

But as the organic was determined just before, it is in fact the real end itself; for in that it maintains itself in the relation to an other, it is precisely that natural being in which nature reflects itself into the concept, and the moments of a cause and of an effect, of an acting and a suffering, which are laid apart on necessity, are taken together into one, so that here something appears not only as the result of necessity; but because it has returned into itself, the last or the result is just as much the first, which begins the movement, and is for itself the end which it realizes.
The organic does not bring forth something, but only maintains itself; or what is brought forth is already present just as much as it is brought forth.
zh: 如果说刚才提到的有机体对元素性自然的关系并没有表达出有机体的本质，那么它反倒包含在目的概念里。
不过对这个观察着的意识来说，它并不是有机体自己的本质，而是落在有机体之外，于是只是那种外在的目的论关系。
但有机体像刚才那样被规定下来，它实际上就是实在的目的本身；因为它在对其他东西的关系中保持住自己，所以它正是那种自然本质，在它里面，自然把自己反思到概念之中，而原因与结果、能动者与受动者这些在必然性上被分开的环节则被合并为一，以致在这里，某物不只是作为必然性的结果而出现；而是因为它已经返回到自身之中，所以最后的东西或结果同样是最初的东西，是最先开始运动的东西，并且对自己来说就是它所实现的那个目的。
有机体并不产生出什么，而只是保持自己，或者说，被产生出来的东西，在它被产生出来的同时，就已经同样地现成存在着。

en: This determination is to be discussed more closely, as it is in itself and as it is for the instinct of reason, in order to see how the latter finds itself therein, yet does not recognize itself in its finding.

The concept of end, then, to which observing reason raises itself, is, as it is reason's conscious concept, likewise present as something actual, and is not merely an external relation of the actual, but its essence.

This actual thing, which is itself an end, relates itself purposively to an other, which means: its relation is a contingent one, according to what both immediately are; immediately, both are independent and indifferent to each other.

But the essence of their relation is other than they thus seem to be, and their doing has another sense than it immediately has for sensuous perception; necessity is hidden in what happens and shows itself only at the end, but in such a way that precisely this end shows that it has also been the first.
The end, however, shows this priority of itself through the fact that through the change which the doing has brought about, nothing other comes out than what already was.

Or if we begin from the first, then this first, at its end or in the result of its doing, only returns to itself; and precisely thereby it proves to be such a one as has itself for its end, thus as first has already come back to itself, or is in and for itself.
What it thus reaches through the movement of its doing is itself, and that it reaches only itself is its self-feeling.
There is hereby indeed the difference between what it is and what it seeks, but this is only the semblance of a difference, and thereby it is concept in its own self.
zh: 这个规定，就其自在而言、以及就其对理性本能而言，还需要更切近地讨论，以便看看理性本能如何在其中找到自己，却又在自己的发现中不认识自己。
那么，观察的理性所上升到的目的概念，作为它有意识的概念，同样作为现实的东西而存在，并且不只是这个现实东西的一种外在关系，而是它的本质。
这个本身就是一个目的的现实东西，合目的地对待其他东西，意思是说：它的关系是偶然的，这是就两者直接所是的样子而言；直接说来，两者都是独立的、彼此漠不相关。
但它们的关系的本质却不同于它们这样显得所是的样子，它们的作为也有另一种含义，不同于它直接对感性的知觉所具有的含义；必然性在发生的事情上是隐藏的，只在最后才显示出来，但却是这样显示出来的，即正是这个最后的东西表明，它也曾是最初的东西。
而最后的东西则通过这一点显示出自身的这种优先性：通过作为所造成的改变，产生出来的不是别的，正是已经存在过的东西。
或者，如果我们从最初的东西开始，那么这东西在它的终点、或在它的作为的结果那里，只是返回到自身；而正因如此，它就表明自己是这样一个东西：它把自身作为自己的终点，所以作为最初的东西就已经返回到自身，或者已经是自在自为的。
所以，它通过自己的作为的运动所达到的东西，就是它自己；而它只达到自己，这就是它的自我感觉。
诚然，由此就出现了它是什么与它寻求什么之间的区别，但这只是区别的假象，而它由此在自己身上就是概念。

en: But self-consciousness is likewise so constituted as to distinguish itself from itself in such a way that at the same time no difference comes out.

In the observation of organic nature it therefore finds nothing other than this essence; it finds itself as a thing, as a life, but it still makes a difference between what it itself is and what it has found, which however is none.
Just as the instinct of the animal seeks and consumes food, but thereby brings out nothing other than itself, so too the instinct of reason in its seeking finds only itself.
The animal ends with self-feeling.
The instinct of reason, by contrast, is at the same time self-consciousness; but because it is only instinct, it is put on one side as against consciousness and has its opposite in the latter.
Its satisfaction is therefore split by this opposite; it indeed finds itself, namely the end, and likewise this end as a thing.
But the end falls for it, first, outside the thing which presents itself as end.
This end as end is, secondly, at the same time objective; it therefore falls for it not into itself as consciousness, but into another understanding.
zh: 但自我意识的情况同样如此：它这样把自己同自己区别开来，而其中同时却没有产生出任何差别。
因此它在对有机自然的观察中所找到的不是别的，正是这个本质；它发现自己是一个物、是一个生命，但它还在它自己所是的东西和它所找到的东西之间作出一个区别，而这个区别却并不是区别。
正如动物的本能寻找并吃掉饲料，但由此产生出来的不是别的，正是它自己，理性的本能也同样在它的寻找中只找到它自己。
动物终止于自我感觉。
而理性的本能同时是自我意识；但因为它只是本能，它就被搁到与意识相对的一边，并且在意识那里有自己的对立面。
因此它的满足被这个对立面分裂开来；它固然找到了自己，也就是找到了目的，并且同样找到了作为物的这个目的。
但这个目的对它来说首先落在那个把自己表现为目的的物之外。
这个作为目的的目的，其次同时是对象性的；因此它也不落在作为意识的它自己之中，而是落在另一个知性里。

en: Considered more closely, this determination lies just as much in the concept of the thing, that it is end in itself.

For it maintains itself, i.e. at the same time it is its nature to hide necessity and to present it in the form of contingent relation; for its freedom, or its being-for-itself, is precisely this, to comport itself toward its necessary as toward something indifferent; it therefore presents itself as something whose concept falls outside its being.

Likewise reason has the necessity of intuiting its own concept as falling outside it, hence as a thing, as something toward which it, and which in turn toward it and toward its concept, is indifferent.
As instinct it also remains standing within this being or indifference, and the thing which expresses the concept remains for it an other than this concept, the concept an other than the thing.

Thus the organic thing is for it an end in itself only in such a way that the necessity which presents itself in its doing as hidden, in that the doer therein comports itself as an indifferent being-for-itself, falls outside the organic itself.
— But since the organic, as end in itself, cannot comport itself otherwise than as such a one, this too is appearing and sensuously present, that it is end in itself, and it is observed thus.
The organic shows itself as something self-maintaining and as something returning into itself and returned into itself.

But in this being this observing consciousness does not recognize the concept of end, or does not recognize this, that the concept of end does not exist elsewhere somewhere in an understanding, but precisely here, and is as a thing.
It makes a difference between the concept of end and being-for-itself and self-maintenance, which is none.

That it is none is not for it, but a doing that appears contingent and indifferent to what comes about through it; and the unity which after all ties both together — that doing and this end — falls apart for it.
zh: 更仔细地看，这个规定同样包含在物的概念里：物以自身为目的。
因为它保持自己，这同时也就是说，隐藏必然性并以偶然关系的形式把它表现出来，是它的本性；因为它的自由、或它的自为存在正是这一点：对它身上必然的东西采取漠不相关的态度；所以它就把自己表现为这样一个东西，它的概念落在它的存在之外。
同样，理性也有这样的必然性：把自己的概念直观为落在它之外的东西，因而直观为物，直观为这样一个东西：理性对它、而它也因此对理性、并对自己的概念都漠不相关。
作为本能，它也停留在这种存在或这种漠不相关之内，而那个表达着概念的物对它来说仍然是不同于这个概念的另一东西，概念也仍然是不同于物的另一东西。
所以，有机的物对理性来说之所以以自身为目的，仅仅是这样：那种在它的作为中表现为隐藏着的必然性，由于行动者在这种作为中作为漠不相关的自为存在者而行事，就落在有机体自身之外。
——但由于有机体作为以自身为目的的东西，只能作为一个这样的东西而行事，所以它是以自身为目的，这一点也就显现着、感性地当前在场，而它也就这样被观察。
有机体显示出自己是一个自己保持自己的东西，一个返回自身之中并且已经返回自身的东西。
但在这个存在中，这个观察着的意识并不认识目的概念，或者说并不认识这一点：目的概念并不是在别的什么地方、在某个知性里存在，而恰恰是在这里存在，并且是作为一个物而存在。
它在目的概念与自为存在和自身保持之间作出一个区别，而这个区别并不是区别。
这个区别并不是区别，这一点并不为它而存在，反倒是它的行动显现为偶然的、并且对通过它而产生出来的东西漠不相关；而那种毕竟把两者联结起来的统一，——即那种行动和这个目的——，在它那里却分离开来。

en: What in this view belongs to the organic itself is the activity lying midway between its first and its last, insofar as it has in it the character of individuality.
But the activity, insofar as it has the character of universality and the acting one is equated with what is thereby brought forth, the purposive activity as such, would not belong to it.
That individual activity, which is only a means, falls through its individuality under the determination of a wholly individual or contingent necessity.

What the organic does for the preservation of itself as an individual or of itself as a genus is therefore, according to this immediate content, wholly without law, for the universal and the concept fall outside it.
Its activity would accordingly be empty efficacy without content in itself; it would not even be the efficacy of a machine, for this has a purpose and thereby its efficacy has a determinate content.

Thus abandoned by the universal, it would be the activity only of something existing as existing, that is, one not at the same time reflected into itself, as is that of an acid or a base; an efficacy that can neither detach itself from its immediate determinate being nor give up this determinate being, which is lost in the relation to its opposite, and yet preserve itself.

But the being whose efficacy is the one considered here is posited as a thing that preserves itself in its relation to its opposite; the activity as such is nothing but the pure, essenceless form of its being-for-itself, and its substance, which is not merely determinate being but the universal, its purpose, does not fall outside it; it is activity that in itself returns into itself, not activity redirected into itself by something alien.
zh: 在这个看法里属于有机体自身的东西，是它介于自己的最初者和最后者之间的活动，只要这活动在它身上具有个别性的特征。
但行动，只要它具有普遍性的特征，并且行动者被等同于由此产生出来的东西，那么合目的的行动本身就不会属于它。
那个仅仅行动手段的个别行动，通过它的个别性落到了完全个别的、或偶然的必然性这一规定之下。
有机体为了保存自己作为个体、或保存自己作为类所做的事情，就这个直接内容来看，因此是完全没有规律的，因为普遍者和概念落在它之外。
这样一来，它的行动就是在它自己身上没有内容的空洞的效力；它甚至不是一部机器的效力，因为机器有一个目的，它的效力由此有一个确定的内容。
这样被普遍者抛弃以后，它就会只是一个作为存在者的存在者的活动，也就是一种不同时反思到自身之中的活动，如同酸或碱的活动那样；这是一种既不能从自己的直接定在中分离出来、也不能放弃这个在与对立物的关系中消失掉的定在、而同时又保持住自己的效力。
但那个其效力在此被考察的存在者，是被设定为在与对立物的关系中保持住自己的物；活动本身不过是它的自为存在的纯粹无本质的形式，而它的实体——这实体不只是特定的存在，而是普遍者——以及它的目的并不落在它之外；它是自身内在地返回自身的活动，而不是被某种异己的东西引导回自身的活动。

en: But this unity of universality and activity is not for this observing consciousness, because that unity is essentially the inner movement of the organic and can be grasped only as concept; observation, however, seeks the moments in the form of being and permanence; and because the organic whole is essentially this — not to have the moments in it and not to let them be found in it — consciousness in its view transforms the opposition into one such as is conformable to it.

In this way the organic being arises for it as a relation of two existing and fixed moments, — an opposition whose two sides thus seem to it, on the one hand, to be given in observation, and on the other hand, according to their content, to express the opposition of the organic purpose-concept and actuality; but because the concept as such is extinguished in it, in a dark and superficial manner, in which thought has sunk down into representation.
Thus we see the first meant approximately under the inner, the other under the outer, and their relation produces the law that the outer is the expression of the inner.
zh: 但普遍性与活动的这种统一，正因如此并不是为这个观察着的意识的，是因为那种统一本质上是有机体的内在运动，只能作为概念被把握；而观察却以存在和持续的形式去寻找那些环节；并且因为有机整体本质上就是不在自己身上拥有这些环节、也不让人在自己身上找到它们，所以意识在自己的看法中把对立变成了符合它自身的那种对立。
这样在它那里就产生了有机本质，作为两个存在着的、固定的环节的关系，——这是一种对立，它的两个方面在它看来因此一方面显得是在观察中被给予的，另一方面按其内容又表达出有机目的概念与现实性的对立；但因为概念本身在它上面被抹掉了，是以一种晦暗而肤浅的方式，在其中思想已经沉降为表象。
于是我们看到，第一个大致被意谓为内在的东西，另一个被意谓为外在的东西，而它们的关系产生出这条规律：外在的东西是内在东西的表现。

en: If this inner with its opposite and their relation to one another is considered more closely, it turns out that, first, the two sides of the law no longer read as in earlier laws, in which they appeared as independent things, each as a particular body, nor, second, in such a way that the universal should have its existence somewhere else outside what exists.

Rather, the organic being is posited throughout as undivided, as the content of the inner and the outer, and the same for both; the opposition is thereby only a purely formal one, whose real sides have the same in-itself as their essence, but at the same time, since inner and outer are also opposed reality and a being different for observation, they seem to it each to have a content of its own.

But this content of its own, since it is the same substance or organic unity, can in fact only be a different form of the same; and this is indicated by the observing consciousness in that the outer is only the expression of the inner.
— The same determinations of the relation, namely the indifferent independence of the different things and, in it, their unity, in which they vanish, we have seen in the purpose-concept.
zh: 把这个内在的东西连同它的对立物以及它们彼此的关系更仔细地看一看，就可看出：第一，这条规律的两个方面不再像早先那些规律里那样表述，在那些规律里它们作为独立的东西各自显现为一个特殊的物体；第二，也不再是这样，即普遍者应当在存在者之外的某个地方拥有自己的存在。
相反，有机本质整个儿被不加分割地放到基础上，作为内在东西和外在东西的内容，并且对两者是同一个东西；对立由此只是一个纯粹形式上的对立，它的那些实在的方面以同一个自在作为自己的本质，但同时，因为内在东西和外在东西也是对立着的实在性和对观察来说不同的存在，所以它们在观察看来各自显得有一个自己所特有的内容。
但这个自己所特有的内容，由于它是同一个实体或有机统一，实际上只能是这同一个东西的不同形式；而这一点被观察着的意识这样暗示出来：外在的东西只是内在东西的表现。
——我们在目的概念上已经看到过关系的这些同样的规定，即不同者的漠不相关的独立性以及它们在其中消失的统一。

en: It is now to be seen what shape the inner and the outer have in their being.
The inner as such must have an outer being and a shape just as much as the outer as such, for it is posited as object, or as itself existing and present for observation.
zh: 现在要看的是，内在的东西和外在的东西在它们的存在中具有怎样的形态。
内在的东西本身必定同样有一个外在的存在和一个形态，就像外在的东西本身那样，因为它被设定为对象，或者被设定为本身存在着并为了观察而现成存在的东西。

en: The organic substance as inner is the simple soul, the pure purpose-concept or the universal, which in its division remains equally universal fluidity and therefore appears in its being as the activity or the movement of vanishing actuality; whereas the outer, opposed to that existing inner, consists in the resting being of the organic.

The law, as the relation of that inner to this outer, thereby expresses its content now in the presentation of universal moments or simple essences, and now in the presentation of realized essence or shape.
Those first simple organic properties, to call them so, are sensibility, irritability and reproduction.
These properties, at least the first two, seem indeed to refer not to the organism in general but only to the animal one.

The vegetable one, too, in fact expresses only the simple concept of the organism, which does not develop its moments; therefore, with regard to them, insofar as they are to be for observation, we must hold to the one that presents their developed determinate being.
zh: 有机实体作为内在的东西，是单纯的灵魂，是纯粹的目的概念或普遍者，这普遍者在自己的划分中同样保持为普遍的流动性，因此在自己的存在中显现为正在消失的现实性的行动或运动；与此相反，外在的东西与那个存在着的内在东西相对立，存在于有机体的静止的存在之中。
规律作为那个内在东西与这个外在东西的关系，由此把自己的内容时而表述为普遍环节或单纯本质的陈述，时而表述为被实现了的本质或形态的陈述。
那些最初的、单纯有机的特性——如果这样称呼它们的话——是感受性、应激性和繁殖。
这些特性，至少前两个，看来确实不是就一般有机体而言，而只是就动物有机体而言。
植物性的有机体实际上也只表达有机体的单纯概念，而这一概念还没有展开自己的那些环节；因此，就这些环节来说，只要它们应当为观察而存在，我们就必须守住那个把它们的展开的定在陈述出来的有机体。

en: As regards these properties themselves, they follow immediately from the concept of the self-purpose; for sensibility expresses in general the simple concept of organic reflection-into-itself or the universal fluidity of it, while irritability expresses the organic elasticity of comporting itself in reflection as at the same time reacting, and the actualization opposed to the first, calm being-within-itself, in which that abstract being-for-itself is a being for another.

Reproduction, however, is the action of this whole organism reflected into itself, its activity as purpose in itself or as genus, in which the individual therefore repels itself from itself, reproducing either its organic parts or the whole individual.

Taken in the sense of self-preservation in general, reproduction expresses the formal concept of the organic or sensibility; but it is properly the real organic concept or the whole, which returns into itself either as individual through the production of the individual parts of itself or as genus through the production of individuals.
zh: 至于这些特性本身，它们直接就从自我目的的概念中产生出来，因为感受性一般而言表达有机的自身反思这一单纯概念，或它的普遍流动性，而应激性则表达有机的弹性，即在反思中同时作出反应地行事，以及那个与最初的、静止的自身内存在相对立的现实化，在其中那个抽象的自为存在是一种为他存在。
而繁殖则是这个整个地反思到自身之中的有机体的行动，是它作为自在的目的、或作为类的活动，在其中个体因此把自己从自己那里排斥出去，要么产生出自己的有机部分，要么产生出整个个体来重复自己。
如果从一般自我保存的意义上来理解，繁殖表达的是有机物的形式概念或感受性；但它其实是实在的有机概念或整体，这个整体要么作为个体通过产生自身的各个部分、要么作为类通过产生个体而返回自身。

en: The other meaning of these organic elements, namely as the outer, is their shaped manner, according to which they are present as real, but at the same time also as universal parts or organic systems; sensibility, for instance, as the nervous system, irritability as the muscular system, reproduction as the viscera of the preservation of the individual and of the genus.
zh: 这些有机要素的另一个含义，即作为外在的东西，是它们成形的样式，按照这种样式，它们作为现实的、但同时作为普遍的部分或有机系统而现成存在；例如感受性作为神经系统，应激性作为肌肉系统，繁殖作为保存个体和类的内脏。

en: The peculiar laws of the organic therefore concern a relation of the organic moments in their doubled significance: once of being a part of the organic formation, the other time a universal fluid determinacy which runs through all those systems.

In the expression of such a law, therefore, e.g. a determinate sensibility would have its expression as a moment of the whole organism in a determinately formed nervous system, or it would also be linked with a determinate reproduction of the organic parts of the individual or propagation of the whole, and so on.
– The two sides of such a law can be observed.

The external is according to its concept being for another; sensibility, e.g., has in the sensible system its immediately actualized mode; and as universal property it is likewise, in its expressions, something objective.
The side which is called the inner has its own external side, which is distinguished from what in the whole is called the external.
zh: 所以，有机物的固有规律涉及有机环节在它们双重含义中的一种关系，即一个时候是有机形态的一个部分，另一个时候是贯穿所有那些系统的普遍流动的规定性。
所以，在这样一条规律的表述中，例如一种特定的感受性作为整个有机体的环节，会在一个特定地形成了的神经系统那里有自己的表述，或者它也会与个体有机部分的特定再生产或整体的繁殖等等结合在一起。
——这样一条规律的两个方面是可以被观察的。
外在的东西按它的概念就是为他存在；例如感受性在感受系统里有它直接实现了的方式；而作为普遍属性，它在自己的种种表现中同样是一个对象性的东西。
那被称为内在的方面有它自己的外在方面，这个外在方面与整体上被称为外在的东西是有区别的。

en: The two sides of an organic law would therefore indeed be observable, but not laws of their relation; and observation does not suffice for this not because, as observation, it would be too short-sighted and would not proceed empirically, but should start from the idea – for such laws, if they were something real, would in fact have to be really present and thus observable –, but because the thought of laws of this kind proves to have no truth.
zh: 所以，一条有机规律的这两个方面固然是可以观察的，但不是它们的关系的规律；而观察之所以不够，并不是因为它作为观察太短视、不是经验地行事，反而应当从观念出发——因为这样的规律，如果它们是某种实在的东西，就确实必须现实地存在，因而可以被观察——，而是因为关于这类规律的这种思想表明自己没有任何真理。

en: For a law there resulted the relation that the universal organic property had made itself into a thing on an organic system and had on it its formed imprint, so that both would be the same essence, present once as universal moment, the other time as thing.

But besides this, the side of the inner is also for itself a relation of several sides, and there therefore first offers itself the thought of a law as a relation of the universal organic activities or properties to one another.
Whether such a one is possible must be decided from the nature of such a property.

But as a universal fluidity it is, on the one hand, not something that is limited in the manner of a thing and holds itself within the difference of a determinate being which should constitute its shape, but sensibility goes beyond the nervous system and through all the other systems of the organism, – on the other hand it is a universal moment which is essentially undivided and inseparable from reaction or irritability and reproduction.
For as reflection-into-itself it has reaction on it absolutely.
Only being-reflected-into-itself is passivity or dead being, not a sensibility, – just as little as action, which is the same as reaction, is irritability without being-reflected-into-itself.
The reflection in action or reaction and the action or reaction in reflection is precisely that whose unity constitutes the organic, a unity which is synonymous with organic reproduction.

It follows from this that in every mode of actuality the same magnitude of sensibility must be present as of irritability – we consider first the relation of the latter and of irritability to each other –, and that an organic appearance can be grasped and determined just as much according to the one as according to the other or, as one will, explained.
The same thing that one person takes for high sensibility, another can just as well regard as high irritability, and irritability of the same height.

If they are called factors and this is not to be a meaningless word, then it is precisely thereby expressed that they are moments of the concept, thus that the real object whose essence this concept constitutes has them in itself in the same way, and that, if it is determined according to the one as very sensible, it is to be asserted just as much according to the other as equally irritable.
zh: 对一条规律来说得出的关系是：普遍的有机属性在一个有机系统上把自己变成了物，并在它上面有了自己形成起来的印记，以致两者会是同一个本质，一个时候作为普遍的环节、另一个时候作为物而存在。
但除此之外，内在这一方面本身也是多个方面的关系，于是首先提供出来的就是关于一条规律的思想，即把它当作种种普遍的有机活动或属性彼此之间的关系。
这样一条规律是否可能，必须由这样一种属性的本性来决定。
但它作为普遍的流动性，一方面不是某种按物的方式被限制[的东西]，也不是保持在一种定在的差别里、而这种定在应当构成它的形态，而是感受性超出神经系统，并且穿过有机体的所有其他系统，——另一方面它是普遍的环节，本质上与反应或刺激感受性以及再生产不可区分、不可分离。
因为作为自身反思，它绝对地在自己身上有反应。
只有自身内反思存在才是被动性或死的存在，而不是一种感受性，——正像行动，即与反应相同的东西，没有自身内反思存在就不是刺激感受性一样。
行动或反应中的反思与反思中的行动或反应，恰恰就是其统一构成有机物的那个东西，而这个统一与有机的再生产是同义的。
由此得出，在现实性的每一种方式里都必定有与刺激感受性同样大小的感受性——我们先看感受性与刺激感受性彼此的关系——，而且一个有机现象既可以按这一方来把握和规定，也同样可以按另一方来把握和规定，或者随人怎么说，都可以得到解释。
同一样东西，一个人拿来当作高度的感受性，另一个人同样可以看作高度的刺激感受性，而且是以同一个高度。
如果它们被称为因素，而这不应当是一个没有含义的词，那么恰恰由此说出了：它们是概念的环节，所以那个其本质由这个概念构成的实在对象，以同样的方式在自己身上拥有它们，并且，如果它按这一方被规定为很有感受性，那么按另一方它也同样应当被说成同样有刺激感受性。

en: If they are distinguished, as is necessary, they are so according to the concept, and their opposition is qualitative.
But if, besides this true difference, they are also posited as different as existing and for the representation, as they could be sides of the law, then they appear in quantitative difference.

Their peculiar qualitative opposition thus enters into magnitude, and laws arise of the kind that e.g. sensibility and irritability stand in an inverted relation of their magnitude, so that as the one grows the other decreases; or better, taking magnitude itself straight away as the content, that the magnitude of something increases as its smallness decreases.

– But if a determinate content is given to this law, e.g. in such a way that the magnitude of a hole increases the more that decreases which constitutes its filling, then this inverted relation can just as well be converted into a direct one and expressed as that the magnitude of the hole increases in direct relation to the quantity of what is taken away, – a tautological proposition, whether it be expressed as a direct or an inverted relation, which in its peculiar expression means nothing but this, that a magnitude increases as this magnitude increases.

As the hole and that which fills it and is taken away are qualitatively opposed, but as the real element of them and its determinate magnitude is one and the same in both, and likewise increase of magnitude and decrease of smallness is the same, and their meaningless opposition runs out into a tautology, so the organic moments are equally inseparable in their real element and in their magnitude, which is the magnitude of the same; one decreases only with the other and increases only with it, for one has absolutely meaning only insofar as the other is present; – or rather it is indifferent to consider an organic appearance as irritability or as sensibility, already in general, and likewise when its magnitude is spoken of, – as indifferent as it is to express the increase of a hole as increase of it as emptiness or as increase of the fullness taken out.

Or a number, e.g. three, remains equally large whether I take it positively or negatively; and if I enlarge the three to four, then the positive as well as the negative has become four, – as the south pole on a magnet is just as strong as its north pole, or a positive electricity or an acid just as strong as its negative or as the base on which it acts.

– Such a magnitude as that three or a magnet etc. is an organic determinate being; it is that which is increased and decreased, and when it is increased, both factors of it are increased, as much as both poles of the magnet or as the two electricities increase when a magnet etc. is strengthened.

– That both can just as little be different according to intension and extension, that the one cannot decrease in extension and on the contrary increase in intension, while the other, conversely, should diminish its intension and on the contrary increase in extension, falls under the same concept of empty opposition; the real intension is just as absolutely as large as the extension, and conversely.
zh: 如果它们被区分开来，正如必然的那样，那么它们是按概念被区分开来的，而它们的对立是质的对立。
但除了这个真正的差别之外，它们还被设定为存在着的、并且为表象而不同，就像它们能够是规律的诸方面那样，于是它们就显现为量的差别。
它们固有的质的对立由此进入大小之中，于是就产生了这样一类规律，例如感受性和刺激感受性处于它们大小的颠倒关系之中，以致一方增长时另一方减少；或者不如说，直接把大小本身当作内容，就是某物的大小增长时，它的小减少。
——但如果给这条规律一个特定的内容，例如说一个洞的大小增长，而构成它的充实的东西越减少，那么这个颠倒的关系同样可以转化为一个正比关系并表述为：洞的大小按被取走的东西的量成正比地增长，——这是一个同义反复的命题，无论把它表述为正比关系还是颠倒关系，它在自己固有的表述中只意味着这一点：一个大小增长时，这个大小增长。

正如洞与充实它并被取走的东西是质上对立的，但两者的实在物及其特定大小在两者中是同一个东西，同样，大小的增长与小的小减少也是同一个东西，而它们那没有含义的对立流为一个同义反复，有机的诸环节同样在它们的实在物中、在它们的大小中不可分离，而大小是同一个东西的大小；一方只随另一方减少，也只随另一方增长，因为一方绝对地只有在另一方存在的情况下才有含义；——或者不如说，把一个有机现象看作刺激感受性还是看作感受性，根本就是一样的事情，而当谈到它的大小时，也同样一样，——正如把一个洞的增长说成它作为空虚的增长、还是说成被取出的充实的增长，是一样的事情。
或者一个数，例如三，无论我把它当作正的还是负的，它都同样大；而如果我把三增大到四，那么正的和负的都变成了四，——正如磁体上的南极恰恰与它的北极一样强，或者一种正电或一种酸恰恰与它的负电、或与它所作用于其上的碱一样强。
——这样一个大小，如那个三或一个磁体等等，是一个有机的定在；它就是那个被增大和被减小者，而当它被增大时，它的两个因素都被增大，正如磁体的两极、或两种电在磁体等等被加强时同样增长一样。
——两者同样不能按内延和外延而有区别，即一方不能在外延上减少、反而在内延上增长，而另一方则相反，应当减少自己的内延、反而在外延上增长，这一点归在同一个空洞对立的概念之下；实在的内延绝对地与那外延一样大，反过来也一样。

en: As is evident, in this lawgiving things actually proceed in such a way that first irritability and sensibility constitute the determinate organic opposition; but this content loses itself, and the opposition runs out into the formal one of the increase and decrease of magnitude or of the different intension and extension – an opposition which no longer concerns the nature of sensibility and irritability at all and no longer expresses them.

Hence such empty play of lawgiving is not bound to the organic moments, but it can be carried on everywhere with everything and rests in general on unfamiliarity with the logical nature of these oppositions.

If finally, instead of sensibility and irritability, reproduction is brought into relation with the one or the other, then the occasion for this lawgiving also falls away; for reproduction does not stand in an opposition to those moments such as they do to one another; and since this lawgiving rests on that, the semblance of its occurring also falls away here.
zh: 正如已经明白的那样，在这种立规律的做法里，实际情况其实是：首先刺激感受性和感受性构成特定的有机对立；但这个内容消失了，而对立则流为大小增长和减少、或不同内延和外延这种形式上的对立，——这样一种对立已经完全不再涉及感受性和刺激感受性的本性，也不再表达它们。
所以，这种空洞的立规律游戏并不束缚于有机的诸环节，而是到处都可以拿一切东西来做，并且它一般就建立在对于这些对立的逻辑本性毫无认识之上。
最后，如果不用感受性和刺激感受性，而是把再生产与这一方或那一方联系起来，那么这种立规律活动的缘由也就消失了；因为再生产与那些环节并不处于一种像它们彼此之间那样的对立之中；而既然这种立规律活动就建立在那种对立之上，那么它得以成立的假象在这里也就消失了。

en: The law-giving just considered contains the differences of the organism in their significance as moments of its concept, and properly speaking should have been an a priori law-giving.
